name: Averages after drops
value: Quizzes, Participation, Mastering Biology and Guided Reading Questions are each one percent. Enter your average after the drops: lowest 1 quiz, lowest 4 participation days, lowest 3 Mastering assignments and lowest 3 GRQs.

name: Participation bonus
value: A semester Participation average of 75% or better rounds up to 100%, so enter 100 here if yours is at least 75.

name: Lab
value: Lab counts 30%, but the syllabus gives no split for its parts. Enter your overall lab percent. It drops the lowest pre-lab and post-lab scores.

name: Cutoffs
value: The syllabus writes cutoffs as greater than, such as >93=A, and doesn't say what happens at exactly 93. This page counts 93 as an A. No rounding is stated, so none is applied.
